title: Feng Kou Chang

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 297
Dat. 20/6/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

June 19th 1916.

Sir,
The Chinese Telegraph Administration has received instructions from Peking to dispatch free of charge telegrams sent to President Li by the southern leaders concerning political affairs.
Chiangchun Feng Kou Chang 馮國璋 has sent a man to Shanghai to advise Li Ping Su 李平書 to proceed to Nanking.
A detective named Van Sau roo 范少甫 who is employed by Generals Chang Hsun and Nyi Sz Tsung boarded and searched a boat belonging to a Pootung man named Loo Ts Ming 陸子明 near Lungwha on 17th inst. The boatmen raised an alarm to which the local police and soldiers responded. Van was arrested and taken to the Arsenal. When he was searched a letter was found in his possession showing that he had been planning with an Inspector of the City Police to rob a house in Jessfield.
Four hundred and sixty soldiers left the Arsenal for Fokien on 17th inst by the cruiser "Poh Eon".
It is reported that twelve soldiers have deserted from Woosung.
A revolver was stolen from the room of a police sergeant in the 4th district in Chapel on 18th inst.

Your Obedient Servant,

（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

（签名）
Captain Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
刑事侦缉处
情报官登记
第 297 号
日期：16/6/20

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探股）

1916 年 6 月 19 日。

先生：

中国电报局已接到北京指令，对南方领袖就政治事务发给黎总统的电报免收费用予以拍发。

冯国璋已派人前往上海，劝告李平书前往南京。

受张勋将军和倪嗣冲将军雇用的名为范少甫 (Van Sau roo) 的侦探，于本月 17 日在龙华附近登船并搜查了一艘属于浦东人陆子明 (Loo Ts Ming) 的船只。船夫发出警报，当地警察和士兵随即赶到。范被捕并被带往兵工厂。经搜查，在其身上发现一封信件，显示他正与一名华界巡捕房的督察密谋抢劫极司菲尔路 (Jessfield) 的一处住宅。

四百六十名士兵于本月 17 日乘“宝应”号巡洋舰离开兵工厂前往福建。

据报，有十二名士兵从吴淞开小差。

本月 18 日，一支左轮手枪在 Chapel 第四区一名警佐的房间内被盗。

您顺从的仆人，

（签名）
总探长。

（签名）
警务处总监。
